registration: Pending issue #41 plugin API and format-packaging ADR decision; do not add to default registry yet.
detection: Not implemented; pipeline tests inject ReaderRegistry and use format: vsdx. Public MIME mapping is not present, so forced-format pipeline reports application/octet-stream.

features.pages: Declared Pages order resolved through package relationships.
features.text: Core Text_Type text from Shapes (including connector shapes when they carry Text), preserving grouped shape XML source order and multiline Unicode; foreign extension elements are skipped with static warnings.
features.relationships: Only unambiguous internal document/pages/page relations are followed; external relations are reported by shared feature scanning and never fetched. Connects records are not reconstructed.

validation.tests: Vitest unit and injected-registry pipeline tests with hand-reviewed expected blocks.
validation.fixtures: Original synthetic CC0 packages, not Visio-app validated.
validation.goldens: No corpus extraction goldens claimed; test expectations are manually authored from fixture source facts.
